Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest in the sister’s afterborn children who reach 25, triggered by a church use that may occur at any time, can vest outside lives in being plus 21 years, so the common-law RAP voids it and the friend holds fee simple absolute.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s own ‘hitherto’ limits the aphorism to past progressive societies, and the standard misreading treats that historical description as a prediction of future legal change.

Q5649.reason: Immediate post-operative care is a recognized contraindication because output must be measured continuously, whereas patient choice, bladder sensation, and no need to measure urine are reasons to use a valve.
